Absent from the directory: the mechanism's source/config (trigger, threshold, "live background job" definition, wake-message text), the idle-agent logs, and the owner's rules file. The only file is an empty `.wf-mcp.json`. I relied on your description, and no collision check was possible.

**(1) Candidates**
- `idle-wake`: wakes silent agents
- `silence-wake`: silence past limit triggers wake
- `stall-wake`: wakes stalled, jobless agents
- `quiet-nudge`: wakes quiet agents
- `dead-wait-wake`: wakes agents waiting forever

**(2) Pick:** `idle-wake`

**(3) Rule:** An agent that stays silent past the time limit with no live background job is woken with a message naming this rule, because it is probably waiting for something that will never arrive, so either keep a background job running or report progress before the limit.
